news.text: #Kessie has two mega offers (one from Saudi Arabia) but wants to wait a few more days for #Juventus's decision. If he has wanted to, he would have already signed elsewhere, he is very intrigued by a return to Serie A but will not wait forever.[Alfredo Pedullà]

👀 #Palermo is still waiting for the results of the medical examinations to which #Joronen will be subjected: in case problems arise that require an intervention in the mercato, the rosanero club is ready to make a move in order to reinforce the goal.In that sense, the profiles of Marco #Sportiello and Michael #Semper are gaining strength, two names that the Sicilian management would be following with attention as possible solutions for the rosanero goal.Mattia #Perin is moving away a bit: the demands of #Juventus have been considered high by the Sicilian club.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]
🔜 Done Deal and confirmed! Emanuele #Pecorino to #Catanzaro from #Juventus. Contract until 2030. #transfers[Nico Schira]
#Avellino are in talks with #Juventus to sign Adin #Licina (born in 2007) on loan until June 2027. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🚨 Excl - #Juventus would like to keep Mattia #Perin as Vicario’s backup. The goalkeeper has received a rich bid from #Palermo (3-years contract). Reflections Underway. Perin would like a contract extension until 2028 to stay at #Juve. Expected a final decision in the next hours[Nico Schira]

🇮🇹❗️"On #DiGregorio, #Juventus is waiting for #Marseille's choice. It is a serious option on the table, the French club is evaluating multiple profiles, but he could be the most affordable solution in terms of costs because it would eventually be a loan, a formula that the bianconero club would be willing to accept. The goalkeeper is inclined to try his luck abroad."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

Confirmed that Michele #DiGregorio is not an option for #Marseille at the moment. The French cannot operate on the mercato without other exits, but, regardless of the financial aspect, the #Juventus goalkeeper is not the first on the list at the moment. #Bulka, #Gill, #Grabara are also liked. #DiGregorio remains on the mercato, even if Mattia #Perin leaves.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

#Palermo, #Joronen will undergo medical tests to evaluate the injury suffered against #Lecce. If it requires a long recovery, #Palermo will present the official offer for Mattia #Perin. @sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]
